main_text.l: ius,vt à Lutheranis, quos vocabant, e-
ne asperserant, vt hac miraculi specie

l.i: Axea quæ fuerat nunc est argentea Virgo,
ed quàm prædones contra,non possit imago
ferrea concludunt illam quæ claustra quibusuis
Vne igitur perges motu sensuque carentem
At,tu Rex,potius nobis hæc secula mutans,
Vid Marti & Musis, Xenophon? Sic Vici-

page.notes: Printed page with a decorative woodcut-style ornament border; the verse opening lines in the first stanza are partly damaged. Several words in the verse are doubtful, notably "Axea", "ferrea", and "Vne"; the initial letters of "Audent" and "Virtutem" are decorative drop caps. The "L" and "O" are decorative initials.
